changes: v5: every page fits a 240-unit-tall screen (container y -9..231). Only page art, three text rows and the foot-bar faces changed; no slot role, no slot row and no header text row moved.

v5: kit pages: book box y bookY..228 (was -19..241), where bookY is per kit, 0 to 11 (kits.<kit>.bookY): the highest book top, not above 11, at which the composed page has no transparent pixel inside the container rectangle (x 0..175, y 0..221). The vanilla chest background is drawn under the page, so a lower band would leave the chest's top edge bare. The top band lies at y bookY+4-h..bookY+4 (h = top.ground.h), partly behind the header line; props stand above it up to y -8. The header wash is the strip between the band and the paper (0 to 11 units, by kit). Paper starts at y 17 as before. No divider rule.

v5: the composer gets a virtual screen of 320x240 with the container at (72, 9) and a content keep box of y 16..210 only (no keep boxes for ribbon or chips). It then drops, never cuts, every prop that would leave the screen. Per kit result in `kits`.
v5: plain tome page (Skills): book box y -7..228, cover -9..231; header line inside it at y 1 as before.

v5: foot: scene zone is y 210..226 (16 units), foot ground 226..230. To clear it, the foot-bar control faces on the hotbar row are 13 tall, y 197..209 (were 16 to 18 tall): art-v5/ctl13/*.png. Slots and click boxes are unchanged. The page count text is at y 200 (was 201).
v5: Mutate: seal label text y 192 (was 197), warning y 201 (was 207), so no text lies in the scene zone.

v5: recommended, not required: no crumb ribbon on kit pages whose first row already shows the full name (Skill, Adaptation, Mutate); the ribbon hides the left half of the top band. Keep the ribbon where the name does not fit row 0 (long mutated names) and on Skills. Chips stay at y 1..15 on the right in every case. header.crumbOnKitPages records this.
v5: ledger pages: art at (-10,-9), height 114 + 18*rows + 18 (was (-10,-12), + 24): art-v5/ledger5/page_r<rows>.png, without the strap; the vanilla Inventory label shows.

v5: fallback: same page boxes; the hotbar-row wells are 14 tall (y 196..209) so the foot scene clears them. Fallback pages may also be composed with the keep box ending at 214 if full wells are preferred (foot scenes then lose their 13 to 16 tall actors).
v5: the spread (framing B) is removed from the spec: framings.B, screens.B and artSlots.B are gone.

v5: artSlots hosts are unchanged (22, 31, 40, 85; fallback foot 46); the per-kit cell lists were recomputed for the new art and are in animation-regions-v5.json. Every cell of every kit has a host in both modes.

v4: lower slot rows corrected to the client's chest menu: inventory rows y 139, 157, 175 and hotbar y 197 (were 140, 158, 176, 198); 18 + rows*18 + 13 and +58 for the hotbar. grid.rowY, ledger inventoryRowY and hotbarY, the Mutate seal label (y 197) and the adaptation-levels knowledge mark (y 175) moved up 1. Chest rows (18 + 18r) and columns (8 + 18c) are unchanged.

v3: animated dressing is carried by fixed host slots that hold nothing else (artSlots). The old rule (nearest slot, as a layer of that slot's item) is withdrawn. animation-regions.json cells gained host and hostFallback (slot index or null = still); their old slot field is removed.

v3: one role moved. Framing B, Skill page: skill.mutate is slots 6-7 (was 6-8); slot 8 is a host. No slot moved in framing A, the fallback or the ledger: their hosts were already empty on every themed screen.
v3: item reach used for the assignment is the conservative 144 left/up, 184 right/down.

v2: no client text above container y=5. The header line moved down 12 units onto the vanilla title line: ribbon and chips top y=1 (was -11), crumb and chip text y=5 (was -7). Text rows -7 (book screens) and 0 (ledger) are gone; row 5 is new. No other text row moved.

v2: PageSpec for the composer changed to match: headerTop = inner top + 12 (container y 1), divider = inner top + 8 (y -3, now above the header line), bodyTop = inner top + 28 (y 17). Everything from the page top down to y=4 is art only. All pages/<set> stills and animation strips were re-rendered; animation-regions.json cells changed with them.
v2: ledger breadcrumb ribbon at (4,1), text y=5; the header rule was removed from art/ledger/page_r*.png.
v2: added screens.fallback (top rows only, 54 slots) and the fallback section; fallback always uses framing A.
v2: added retitle facts from the menu spike and art/manifest.json for the bake lane.
v2: Mutate candidates tooltip order is partner name, mutated name, reason; seal role text shortened. Slot numbers of every non-fallback screen are unchanged from v1.
units: GUI units relative to the top-left of the 176x222 container of a 9x6 chest; screen position is floor((guiW-176)/2), floor((guiH-222)/2)
provisional: Every x and y of text and paint may still move by a few units after the owner picks a framing; slot roles are the stable part.
Text rows: one font per distinct y listed in textRows, all at y >= 5 (ascent = 7 - (y - 6), never above the provider height). The list is not yet reduced to a smaller set.

Animation: 60 frames at 4 ticks cut from a 12 s window of the composer clock. Pieces whose period does not divide the loop jump once per loop; the bake should re-time each piece to the loop or pick a per-kit loop (scene periods 9 to 16 s).

Spread (B): dressing cells left of x=-118 have no host and stay still (host=null in animation-regions.json). Freeing a column-0 slot on the spread would recover about 18 units of the top and foot bands but not the far-left wall.
Small text (a 5 px font for long adaptation names and margin levels) is not designed; long names are cut with two dots and carried in the tooltip.

The server cannot see the client screen size. At auto GUI scale a 2560x1440 or 1280x720 window is 426x240 units: the 260-tall page loses 10 units top and bottom in both framings, and the spread loses 17 units each side. Text on the spread stays inside x -122..298 for that reason; the top and foot bands are cut on such screens.
Old targets without item_model (1.20.1, 1.21.1): no layout for them here.
Sample values (levels, costs, stat numbers) in the mock are invented; names, descriptions and icons are real.

itemReach.note: conservative reach of an oversized_in_gui item beyond its 16x16 slot box

text.font: vanilla ASCII sheet, glyph cell 8 tall, advance = glyph width + 1, space 4; widths from core PackFontMetrics

rowLines.note: tile and card text sits one unit higher (rowY - 1 + offset)

text.big: the same sheet at twice the size (provider height 16), used for the mutated name only
text.nonLatin: unifont text stays on the title line, so every label that is only title text also appears in a tooltip of a slot in the same group

pageSpec.bookY: per kit: start at 11 and lower by 1 until the still page is fully opaque over x 0..175, y 0..221; values for the shipped kits are in kits.<kit>.bookY
pageSpec.headerKeeps: none: the header line is drawn over the top band, so pass no keep box for ribbon or chips and no hang exclusion
pageSpec.mutatedLeaf: leaf 1: the lead page with the partner kit on the outer edge

header.ribbon: stretchable: the kit ribbon drawn as glyphs behind the crumb text; width = text + 12
header.chips: unchanged: y 1..15, right-aligned, numbers at y 5; they sit on the band
header.crumbs: leading crumbs are dropped until the ribbon fits beside the chips
header.wash: the strip between the band bottom (bookY + 4) and the paper (y 17); the header line is drawn over band and wash
header.crumbOnKitPages: recommended off where row 0 shows the full page name; on for long mutated names and on the Skills page

flow.skillPage: row 0 identity; rows 1-8 hold 16 cells per leaf in two columns of 8 (slot columns 0-3 and 5-8), filled down the left column then the right. A group heading takes one cell and never sits in the last row of a column. Kept originals follow under a "Kept" heading, four per cell. More cells go to the next leaf.
flow.adaptationCell: 4 slots: icon, then three clear slots under a name of up to two 9 px lines (53 wide). Level pips and "learned/max" sit in the page margin beside the row (left of column 0, right of column 8); on the spread the outer paper also carries the next step.
flow.skillsA: 12 cards per leaf, 3 slots by 2 rows each, seats in catalogue order; leaf 0 holds seats 0-11, leaf 1 seats 12-23.
flow.skillsB: 12 tokens per page (4 by 3, one slot each over a clear slot holding the level), with a 12-line index on the outer paper in the same order.

sprites.rule: Controls are 16x16 item sprites on their slot. Button, chip, field and tile faces are baked paint under clear slots. Oversized sprites: pip ring 18x18 (-1,-1), seal mark 22x22 (-3,-3), seal fill 18x18 (-1,-1), armed wash 54x18, page-turn sheets, dressing cells.

states.dim: a greyed copy of the icon for level 0, locked and lost entries
states.tint: pip/fill.png and seal/fill_*.png are white and tinted with the skill ink

sprites.clear: a clear item carries the click and tooltip of its group; a clear item with hidden tooltip carries dressing cells only

dressing.source: pages/<set>/anim.png, cells side by side, frames stacked downward
dressing.rule: each cell is an opaque patch of the dressing over its box; a host item carries all cells assigned to it as one sprite (see artSlots); cells under a content plate are dropped; cells with no host stay in the still page art

seal.idle: mark glints: 4 frames of 4 ticks, then rest 64 ticks
seal.arm: first click: the three segments each side fill from the outer ends inward, one step per 8 ticks (server slot swaps or the cooldown clock), in the lead and partner inks
seal.armed: mark glints every 3 ticks for 3 s; a second click confirms; otherwise the fill drains

animation.armedButton: Unlearn and Reset: first click swaps the label to Confirm and blinks a wine wash over the button every 6 ticks for 3 s

pageTurn.how: a paper sheet sweeps each paper box left to right on page-spanning oversized items, then the title is resent once

animation.recipe: alternative ingredients cycle every 24 ticks by slot update
animation.hud: cooldown wipe: 8 clock steps over the ability glyph

ledger.rule: any other chest menu of 1-6 rows keeps its slots, clicks and item names; paint is art-v5/ledger5/page_r<rows>.png at (-10,-9); container height 114+18*rows; breadcrumb on a ribbon at (4,1), text y=5; no strap, the vanilla Inventory label shows; the player inventory stays real and sits in the baked wells

artSlots.rule: A host slot holds one invisible item with hidden tooltip whose model is the animated sprite of all cells assigned to it; a click on it does nothing. Host slots never hold content on any themed screen of their mode (every skill, leaf, tab, the mutated variant, Mutate, armed states: checked by src/free.js). Hosts have low indices or sit in the margin rows, and dressing lies outside the content boxes, so slot draw order does not matter except under content plates, whose cells are dropped.
artSlots.themedOnly: The Skills screen (plain tome) has no moving dressing: no host items are placed there and its slots keep their content roles (framing A cards cover slots 22, 31 and 40; framing B uses 1, 8 and others).

A.regions: top: cell bottom <= 17 -> top host; foot: cell top >= 214 -> foot host; otherwise left of x=88 -> left host, right -> right host; a cell goes to the host of its region if that host reaches it, else to the next host in the listed order that does, else it is still

A.reach: checked against the v5 art with 144 left/up, 184 right/down: no cell without a host

retitle: menu spike: an in-place retitle keeps cursor, tooltip and carried item, is stable at 10 per second and costs about 1.8 KB, so tab, level and page changes may swap text and page art; all click kinds except middle arrive on all 90 slots
